description: Source code for initializing and configuring LVGL display driver within Zephyr RTOS, including buffer management, logging, and device registration.

methods.name: lvgl_log
methods.description: Logging callback that parses LVGL log buffer and forwards messages to Zephyr logging system.

methods.name: lvgl_allocate_rendering_buffers
methods.description: Allocates and initializes display buffers for LVGL, either statically or dynamically based on configuration.

methods.name: lvgl_init
methods.description: Initializes LVGL, display device, buffers, input devices, and registers the display driver.
